usage.callShape: POST https://x402.orth.sh/tavily/search with JSON body {query, max_results}
usage.outputShape: body.results[].{url, title, content, score} — ranked web results with relevance scores; body.answer (null unless include_answer:true); body.response_time; body.request_id
quirks: answer and follow_up_questions are null by default — pass include_answer:true to get an AI-synthesized answer
raw_content is null by default — pass include_raw_content:true to get full page text
Orthogonal proxy is hosted on Vercel; the direct x402.tavily.com backend is status needs-review and untested
usage.guide: POST {query, max_results} as JSON. Returns body.results[] where each item has url, title, content (cleaned text), and a float score (0–1). Optional: add search_depth ('basic'|'advanced'), topic ('general'|'news'|'finance'), include_answer:true for an AI-synthesized answer, or include_raw_content:true for full page content. Use the Orthogonal backend (x402.orth.sh/tavily/search) at $0.01; alternatively signalfuse (api.signalfuse.co/v1/gateway/search/tavily) works at $0.012 with the same schema.
